# tenzir_deployment (Resource)

A self-hosted deployment: a Tenzir node that runs where you install it and connects to the platform. It cannot connect until it has a key, which `tenzir_deployment_key` mints, or which the install command in the web UI fetches. Destroying it hands a connected deployment an empty configuration, so it stops its pipelines. For a deployment that Tenzir runs, use `tenzir_hosted_deployment`; for its connection status, the `tenzir_deployment` data source.

Needs `Workspace.createDeployment` and `Deployment.read`, `Deployment.readTracker`, `Deployment.update`, `Deployment.changeTracker` and `Deployment.delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tenzir_deployment" "edge" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
  workspace_id    = tenzir_workspace.soc.id
  name            = "Edge collector"
  branch          = "main"
  auto_deploy     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name. Renaming keeps the deployment's ID and key.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID or slug of the workspace the deployment belongs to.

### Optional

- `auto_deploy` (Boolean) Whether new commits on `branch` deploy on their own. Defaults to `true`. When false, the deployment keeps the configuration it has until someone deploys a commit.
- `branch` (String) The branch of the workspace repository whose configuration the deployment runs. Defaults to `main`. The platform refuses to switch to a branch without commits.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the deployment was created.
- `id` (String) The deployment ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization>/<workspace>/<deployment>, the first two each an ID or a slug.
terraform import tenzir_deployment.edge acme/soc/0b3c5d1e-7f8a-4b2c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
```
